title: Neuron-fibroblast coculture assay to demonstrate presynaptic differentiation induced by the NGL family of cell adhesion molecules
protocol: Grow HEK293T cells on 60-mm culture dishes to around 50% confluency.
Transfect HEK293T cells with Myc-NGL-2 or Myc-NGL-2 ECD by the calcium phosphate method.
Trypsinize the cells after 24–48 hours.
Resuspend 10% of the trypsinized cells from a single 60-mm dish in 1 mL of phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Harvest the cells by centrifugation.
Resuspend harvested cells in 1 mL of PBS.
Add 10% (100 μl) of resuspended cells onto cultured hippocampal neurons at DIV8 grown on a 18-mm coverslip.
Add cytosine arabinoside to the culture medium to a final concentration of 0.5 μM.
Incubate the coculture in the CO2 incubator for 3 days.
Fix the coculture in 4% paraformaldehyde and 4% sucrose in phosphate buffered saline at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Incubate cells with primary antibodies (synapsin I and Myc; 1 μg/ml).
Incubate cells with Cy3- or FITC-conjugated secondary antibodies.
Perform vesicle turnover experiments in parallel with the immunostaining.
Briefly wash the cells with an extracellular solution.
Incubate the cells in high-potassium solution containing synaptotagmin luminal domain antibodies at room temperature for 5 min.
Wash the cells twice with extracellular solution.
Fix the cells and perform immunostaining with appropriate antibodies.
Capture Z-stacked images of randomly chosen HEK293T cells by confocal microscopy using a 63x objective.
Manually trace the boundaries of the transfected cells.
Normalize the integrated synapsin I immunofluorescence from a transfected HEK293T cell by the cell area.
